subject: Remote plugin inventory scope and one vendor extension

findings: The vendor documents UI, item, inventory and permission extensions, plus a paid-plugin license authorization system.
RustSBAuth in this documentation verifies entitlement to vendor plugins; it is not evidence of Steam or EAC player authentication.
The documented rustsb.version command returns the installed extension version. No update or install command was sent.

limitations: Plugin names alone do not establish implementation behavior.
oxide.plugins does not enumerate all loaded extensions. This is not a complete binary inventory.
The local replica plugin sources differ from the remotely listed plugins and cannot rule out remote count hooks.
The extension version response is 1.1.5, while the current vendor page documents 1.1.7; that page does not establish the exact remote binary implementation.
No evidence links this vendor extension to the lower public trusted count or supplies a count repair.
privacy: Administrative endpoints, credentials, raw replies and the full remote plugin list remain in ignored local files.
